transaction.source: Recognize the imported graph before physical evidence assessment. Bind the original importer, generation and class ordinal, immutable style frame, exact dictionary frames, and the same-import typed Standard STYLE row.
transaction.output: Use actual TABLES, CLASSES and staged OBJECTS. Decode the whole version-specific nested TABLESTYLE grammar, normalize only serializer-defined color and handle representations, and compare cell/border fields and reference roles. Preserve the source empty extension dictionary and its owner. Finalization rechecks immutable frames, frozen class and finalized STYLE ledger.
